summary: From fiscal 2008 to 2026, PLEXUS CORP. reported $56.6 billion of revenue and $1.3 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $366 million, which leaves $921 million of owner cash: 1.6% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 10 of 19 years.
In the latest fiscal year, to 2026-10-03, it was -1.5% of revenue.
